# Public conjunctive-guard pressure fixture

These immutable bytes were emitted by Edict's public application build at
`23378720a200651dee1a7f7ff1d68dd213e52be1`, with the checked Echo provider at
`6a7c62fffac968e999b8ecc67c9cd8372d86f237`. The independent verifier report is
accepted and identifies the exact package. `provenance.json` retains the source
hash, raw artifact hashes and the domain-framed package pin.

The application/lawpack closure comes from Jedit PR #302, base
`9e6466150e43afc83966f9fe67c6ddce2f58d5bc`, with the exact pressure source
retained as `ReplaceRange.edict`. The first supplied source is compiled with
its existing `jedit.text@1` lawpack and `.build/echo-provider` copied from the
selected Echo package. No Core, Target IR, package or report was edited.

The source has nested `all` input guards. Current runtime decoding rejects
that compiler/verifier-accepted predicate shape. The regression must execute
the pinned package and compare literal replacement bytes, then refuse failed
range checks. It is test evidence for generic predicate evaluation, not Echo
application semantics, graph mutation, settlement or recovery authority.
